title: Sanctum
hook: The **Sanctum** is your home hall — the place you are when no lawn, battle, or map run is in progress, and where every run returns.

blindSpots.meaning: Where you are playing right now. The Sanctum is a stage — a place to *be*, not a list of websites to click through.
A menu that opens **over** the stage (Creatures, Fusion, Expeditions…). Closing it returns you to the same hall.
The shared set of layer hotkeys and entries. Same keys on every stage. Detail: [layer rail](layer-rail).
Not “main menu.” When nothing else is active, you stand in the hall with creatures, travel, and a sense of what is next.

alsoTrue: The hall and rail are open in this build; some layers behind the rail are still thin. The guided first-run naming ritual is WIP — see [naming ritual](naming-ritual).
You arrive here after [title / save select](save-select).

sections.title: What it is
paras: A summoner’s hall: creatures on display, a way to travel, and a focus on what to do next.
When a lawn, battle, delve, or siege ends, you come back here.

sections.title: What you do here

cards.name: Read the hall
cards.body: Soul balance and summoner level sit on the HUD. Time in the Sanctum does not push you.

cards.name: Open layers
cards.body: Creatures, Fusion, Pacts, Expeditions, and the rest open over the hall without leaving it.

cards.name: Travel
cards.body: Go to the world map (`M` or the map table) or start a lawn run when a match is ready.

cards.name: Collect
cards.body: Take expedition returns that finished while you were away.

sections.note: Expedition timers are wall-clock remaining — not a ticking panic meter in the hall.

sections.title: Layers vs travel
paras: Layers stack over the Sanctum and close back to the same place.
Travel replaces the stage when you leave for Lawn or World — that is a real departure, then you return home afterward.

rows: A layer opens over the hall
You leave for the world map stage

sections.title: First session note
paras: Vision for a brand-new save: the hall starts almost empty; you bind and name your first creature in place.
Until that ritual ships, you still land in the Sanctum and open the rail yourself.

doSteps: Finish [save select](save-select) and land in the hall.
Look around without opening everything — note HUD stocks and any “what next” cue.
Open one layer (Creatures is a safe first), then close it and confirm you are still in the Sanctum.
doNote: Stop when the hall feels like home, not a settings dump. Next: [layer rail](layer-rail) and [unlock beats](unlock-beats).

mixUps.q: Is the Sanctum just the main menu?
mixUps.a: No. It is a home stage. Layers open over it; you stay in the hall.

mixUps.q: Do I lose my place when I open Creatures?
mixUps.a: No. Closing the layer returns you to the same Sanctum.

mixUps.q: Why are some rail entries locked?
mixUps.a: They unlock as you play. Locked entries say what opens them — see [unlock beats](unlock-beats).
Expeditions run on wall-clock whether you watch or not. The hall does not add pressure.
Not finished yet. You can still play from the Sanctum; see [naming ritual](naming-ritual).
